structured_output.what_is_happening: "gascoin" ($gas) was launched on pump.fun through the UsePaid fee-sharing launcher. The description says "Fees to @deobfuscations via UsePaid", and the linked X item is a single status post, not an account. It left the bonding curve for PumpSwap about 2.5 minutes after creation. About 10 minutes after migration it had run +487% to roughly $289k market cap, on $436k volume, 1,697 unique buyers and 1,152 unique sellers. The last 5 minutes carried nearly half of all volume (+148%). The current price is about 29% below the all-time high of 0.000409, so it is volatile near the top. At least 6 other copycat "gascoin" contracts launched within minutes, and one is close behind at $255k market cap with $291k of hourly volume.
